main_body: bare gothic tree trunk and branches with crows
evidence: The tree is drawn as a flat 2D side/front silhouette cutout: the branches are cut off flat at the top edge of the sprite (row 0), the trunk sits on a flat 3px horizontal bar base (rows 60-62) rather than a 3/4 root spread, and no top or overlapping depth volume is shown.

style.evidence: The candidate uses a heavy near-black outline around the entire silhouette and branches, with only 3 brown shades in vertical bands along the trunk and a flat bar at the base, lacking the organic root structure, rich bark texture, and multi-step value modeling of the Beodeul reference trees.
